title: support for django-storage + core storage options
author: fgregg
body_preview: Thanks so much for this great package, which I use all the time!  I was wondering if you would be open to a PR that added support for django-storage + builtin storage options represented like a url, along the lines of search_url?  for S3 shaped storage, maybe something like  ``` s3://AccessKey:SecretKey@host[:port]/bucket ```  thanks for all your work!
